name: Croatia — Croatian parties
intro: compare it with Croatian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Croatia: those represented in the parliament (Sabor) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Sabor) after the 2024 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 151 members.

Možemo.name: Možemo!
Možemo.priorities: Climate action, Affordable housing, Fighting corruption
Možemo.description: Green-left platform that governs Zagreb, focused on housing, public services and clean politics.

SDP.name: Socijaldemokratska partija Hrvatske
SDP.priorities: Fighting corruption, Public services, Workers' rights and wages
SDP.description: Croatia's main centre-left party and the largest opposition force.

Volt.name: Volt Hrvatska
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

HDZ.name: Hrvatska demokratska zajednica
HDZ.priorities: Competitiveness and growth, Defence and support for Ukraine, Traditional family values
HDZ.description: Christian-democratic party that has led Croatia for most of its independence, currently under Prime Minister Andrej Plenković.

Most.name: Most
Most.priorities: Fighting corruption, Traditional family values, Democratic reform
Most.description: Conservative reform party that campaigns against corruption and for traditional family values.

DP.name: Domovinski pokret
DP.priorities: National identity, Reducing immigration, Security and law and order
DP.description: Nationalist Homeland Movement, junior partner in the government since 2024, focused on national identity and migration.
